articles.title: US Treasury yields fall as oil retreats on Iran deal hopes, Fed hike bets ease
articles.excerpt:

Consequently, traders adjusted their predictions for a Federal Reserve interest rate increase in September, leading to significant reductions in two-year and ten-year Treasury yields. The Treasury Department is expected to announce its borrowing plans soon.
